destructive_gate.condition: No remote branch deletion or PR closure until local all-ref Git bundle is confirmed, or every candidate has full reachability proof and user explicitly authorizes deletion.

notes: Classification is assigned for all 60 pre-cleanup branches; there are no unclassified refs in this snapshot.
Deletion remains blocked. Entries whose unique_commit_assessment says individual proof required must receive ancestry/reachability proof before destructive cleanup, even after classification.
Native acceptance evidence is component-specific and is not treated as final integration acceptance. Final acceptance must be against one exact integration SHA.
